items.rationale: E1 mechanism in 'How this works'; the scoring paragraph rewritten in plain words with the quarter-vs-fifth mismatch explained and PMID 8981090 moved into the professional section; HGVS against NM_000511.6 (c.461G>A p.Trp154Ter; c.418A>T p.Ile140Phe, CA122797/CA122800 via lookup_allele_identity) with the legacy numbering beside it; C6: some East Asian studies class se385 homozygotes with non-secretors; and a dated review record. [jmc field=conclusion value_sha256=e4559f4cb6f3 source=independent review 2026-09-27 (scientific reviewer E1, C6, nomenclature; lay reader) recorded=2026-09-27T08:02:15Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]

The previous README described the module as an unpublished, unreviewed test fixture and called the activity scale 'not a published number' without qualification; it is published as antonkulaga/fut2_secretor and the 0.25 does rest on a measurement. The limits section now names the FUT2 alleles this module cannot see (sefus, se302, se571, se685, se849, sedel) and says a true non-secretor carrying one of them can be reported as a secretor. [jmc field=file value_sha256=7e297f80ccab source=author recorded=2026-09-27T01:50:52Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]

Curation to 1.1.0: every factual claim in a conclusion now rests on a paper found by literature search in this pass and read. Changes of substance: the norovirus protection is hedged to strong-rather-than-absolute after Carlsson 2009 (19440360); the non-secretor frequency now names the two studies it comes from (20% of Swedish donors, 25% of a British cohort) instead of a bare 1 in 5; the vague 'may be more prone to certain other infections' is replaced by the measured mumps figures from ALSPAC (68% against 48%) and the type 1 diabetes odds ratio from Smyth 2011; the 4-in-5 secretor figure is qualified to European ancestry; the weak bin now states that it covers one partly-working copy beside a non-working one as well as two partly-working ones. No allele activity value was changed - the Vmax measurement in 8981090 (230 against 1030) agrees with the authored 0.25. [jmc field=rows value_sha256=dc2f7063d717 source=literature (PubMed/Europe PMC, read in this pass) recorded=2026-09-27T01:50:52Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]

E1: FUT2 makes the H sugar in the cells lining mucosal surfaces rather than 'releasing' sugars, and red cell ABO comes from FUT1; M3: the non-working allele was almost absent among Europe's early hunter-gatherers and arrived with Anatolian farmers ~8,000 years ago (PMID 41132048); lay reader: '68% against 48%' to 'compared with 48%'. [jmc field=conclusion value_sha256=36b71a394976 source=independent review 2026-09-27 (scientific reviewer E1, M3; lay reader) recorded=2026-09-27T08:02:15Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]

E1 mechanism as above; E2: heterozygotes are not identical to homozygous secretors - Azad 2018 reports an intermediate phenotype for asthma and arthritis (PMID 30345375); M6: rotavirus claim attributed as well established for norovirus and supported by recent work for common rotavirus strains (PMID 41132048); C2: only two non-working alleles are read, so a secretor result is less certain for East Asian, Pacific and African ancestry (PMID 15809881, PMID 11606829); lay reader: 'more open to' to 'can catch ... more easily' and the unexplained 'Lewis' dropped. [jmc field=conclusion value_sha256=203aba0edda3 source=independent review 2026-09-27 (scientific reviewer E1, E2, M6, C2; lay reader) recorded=2026-09-27T08:02:15Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]

E1 mechanism as above; E3: se385 is common in East Asia (~40% of gene copies, PMID 41132048; se385/se385 16.2% of 316 Chinese participants, PMID 29123975) and the Korean 7-in-100 figure moved to studies.csv and the README; lay reader: 'enzyme activity' replaced by 'about a fifth as much of the gene's work'. [jmc field=conclusion value_sha256=6bbb7a2760fa source=independent review 2026-09-27 (scientific reviewer E1, E3; lay reader) recorded=2026-09-27T08:02:15Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]

Terms are per article, not per source. Five of the ten cited articles are closed or free-to-read with no licence recorded, so their share_alike, commercial_use and redistribution are left blank - unknown, never false - which correctly drops the module's own commercial-use and redistribution answers to unknown on the published card. Smyth 2011 is CC-BY-NC-ND, so only the single unmodified quoted sentence is carried. [jmc field=file value_sha256=92912ba3f720 source=lookup_open_access (Unpaywall/Europe PMC) plus each article's own copyright statement recorded=2026-09-27T01:50:52Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]

The module stated thresholds and activity values with no grounding evidence at all, which validate_module reported on two of three bins. Every PMID was taken from a literature_search result in this session and its title read back. Each quote was located by hand in the fetch_fulltext output for that PMID and extracted with a regex rather than retyped; curator names the agent that located it. doi is left empty so the enricher's DOI cross-check has something independent to compare. [jmc field=file value_sha256=897e1169a096 source=literature (PubMed/Europe PMC, read in this pass) recorded=2026-09-27T01:50:52Z by=Anton Kulaga (with Claude)]
